name: Potok Koretan
subtitle: Karantan, Korentan

en.name: Stream Koretan
en.subtitle: Karantan, Korentan
en.description: The Koretan stream originates along the road Hruševje - Orehek. The water is of excellent quality, it is also used in the municipality of Postojna as a reserve drinking water. A number of smaller tributaries join him on his journey, but they do not significantly affect his wateriness.

description: Potok Koretan izvira ob cesti Hruševje – Orehek. Voda je odlične kakovosti, saj se jo v občini Postojna uporablja kot rezervno zajetje pitne vode. Na njegovi poti se mu pridružijo številni manjši pritoki, ki pa bistveno ne vplivajo na njegovo vodnatost. Potok je hudourniške narave in je v času padavin hitro tekoč in večkrat poplavlja, kar je njegova značilnost po celotnem toku.

name: Nanoščica II. A

en.name: Nanoščica II. A
en.description: The Nanoščica originates as a stream Globoščak under the Nanos Mountain, after which the river was named. The main tributaries of Nanoščica are the Žabovec stream, Šmiheljski potok, Koretan and numerous smaller tributaries, which supplies it with water. The river is of a torrential nature and is rapidly flowing and flooding during the precipitation period, which is its characteristic throughout the river basin.

description: Nanoščica izvira kot potok Globoščak izpod gore Nanos, po kateri je reka dobila ime. Glavni pritoki Nanoščice so potok Žabovec, Šmiheljski potok, Koretan in številni manjši pritoki, ki jo oskrbujejo z vodo. Reka je hudourniške narave in je v času padavin hitro tekoča in večkrat poplavlja, kar je njena značilnost po celotnem porečju.

name: Pivka

en.name: Pivka
en.description: The Pivka river springs out in the Zagorje region, but its river bed stays almost completely dry in the upper stretch for the majority of the year. It is fishable mainly from the confluence with Nanoscica river until it goes underground to the famous Postojna cave.

description: Reka Pivka izvira na območju Zagorja, vendar je njena struga v zgornjem delu večina leta suha. Lovna je predvsem od sotočja z Nanoščico do ponora v znamenito Postojnsko jamo. V njej prevladujejo predvsem veliki ciprinidi in roparice, zlasti ščuke, ki dosegajo velikosti krepko čez meter, ter veliki krapi, ki so v revirju zelo pogosti.

name: Ribnik Bajer Grobišče

en.name: Grobišče pond
en.description: It was built entirely by the members of the Fishing family Postojna. It is dominated by carps of all sizes and weights. The fishing family stocks up to 400 kg of carps annually. There is also a large number of smaller carps as a result of previous years' spawn, and other cyprinid fish species.

description: Je plod lastnega dela RD. V njem prevladujejo krapi vseh velikosti in teže. RD letno v bajer vloži do 400 kg konzumnega krapa, veliko pa je tudi manjših krapov, ki so plod drsti v prejšnjih letih. V bajerju so prisotne še rdečeperke in rdečeoke.

name: Ribnik Bajer pri ribiški koči

en.name: Pond at the fishing hut
en.description: The pond was created on the spot of the excavation of brick-making material. It is dominated by tench, grass carp and carp of all sizes and weight. In addition, the fishing family stocks a lot of carps annually. There is also a large number of smaller carps and other cyprinid fish species.

description: Ribnik je nastal pri izkopavanju materiala za izdelavo opek, od ribjih vrst prevladuje predvsem linj, amur in krap vseh velikosti in teže. RD letno v bajer vloži kar nekaj konzumnega krapa, veliko pa je tudi manjših krapov in linjev, ki so plod drsti v prejšnjih letih. V bajerju so od ribjih vrst še rdečeperke in rdečeoke.
